items.title: Electric Cell and Battery
items.explanation: An electric cell is a portable source of electrical energy with two terminals: positive (+) at the metal cap and negative (–) at the flat disc. A battery is formed by connecting two or more cells together, where the positive terminal of one cell connects to the negative terminal of the next.

items.title: Electric Circuit Components
items.explanation: A torchlight contains an electric cell (battery) and an incandescent lamp. The circuit is completed when the switch is closed, allowing current to flow from the positive terminal through the wire, through the bulb's filament, back to the negative terminal, and back to the battery.
